title: Introducing Builder Central: The No Code AI Workspace for Salesforce
summary: Introducing the all-in-one workspace to build, configure, and deploy agents, apps, and experiences on Salesforce.
body_markdown:
Every company is racing to become an agentic enterprise. But traditional development simply cannot keep up with the surging demand for custom apps and AI agents. Teams are stalled by the friction of zero-to-one builds and siloed workflows that separate business needs from IT execution.


Right now,[88% of IT leaders](https://www.salesforce.com/news/stories/ai-it-demand-gap/) feel they cannot meet this new demand for solutions safely. We are changing that today.


To bridge the gap, many teams turn to standalone AI building tools. But trading enterprise security for speed is a trap. Pushing sensitive data to external tools introduces severe shadow IT risks. Generic AI models lack your unique business context, relying instead on brittle external integrations and manual security configurations.


An AI’s performance depends largely on its foundation — not the model. You need a way to build at the speed of AI without ever leaving your trusted enterprise boundaries.


And that’s why we’re introducing Builder Central.


## One workspace for all of Salesforce


Builder Central bridges the gap between speed and security, enabling admins and business users to accelerate their path from concept to production. We’re uniting the entire experience for creating and configuring on Salesforce. From a single workspace, Builder Central helps you:


- **Manage and control your environments** from one hub. Configure both your testing and live environments, activate features, enforce security best practices, and clean up your orgs.
- **Build with plain, everyday language.** Turn a basic idea into a working app or AI agent instantly through conversation.
- **Deploy**[apps safely](https://www.salesforce.com/platform/devops-tools/) with automated testing, safety checks, and built-in controls.


##


### Powered by Headless Toolkit


Third party builder tools lack business context and force you to create manual integrations for your data. Builder Central is powered by[Headless Toolkit](https://www.salesforce.com/headless/) , which means every app and agent built with it natively understands your business.


Let’s explore how that changes the way you build.


### Contextual grounding


Standalone builder tools require you to manually export schemas and explain your business logic. Builder Central natively reads your unique metadata and Data 360 context, so every build instantly fits how your company works.


### Automatic safety checks


Build safely without extra work. Builder Central automatically spots errors, enforces universal governance rules, and helps you test your build interactively before deployment.


### Built-in trust and security


Innovate without risk on a platform you already trust. Apps and agents automatically inherit your existing user permissions and org configuration. Your data never leaves your company.


## Get started with Builder Central


The Builder Central beta version is now available and lets you create apps and agents, visualize metadata and deploy them into a sandbox with one click. We’ll continue to add capabilities for building and deployment, as well as capabilities from[Setup with Agentforce](https://admin.salesforce.com/blog/2026/setup-with-agentforce-is-generally-available) as we approach general availability.


Ready to start shipping?[Learn more](http://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=platform.builder_central_overview) about Builder Central.
